faq.q: How do I install NordVPN on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for NordVPN and check the developer is Nord Security before tapping Install. Google Play only shows the Install button if your phone is compatible. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Nord Security and may be altered, so the safest way to use NordVPN is the official listing.

NordVPN uses modern encryption, has a no-logs policy that has been independently audited, and is published by Nord Security on Google Play. As with any VPN, you're trusting the provider with your traffic.
